headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30-31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save. In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, with Jacob Webb earning the win, while the Kansas City Royals fell short in Minnesota, losing 3-4 to the Twins.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Texas Rangers right-hander Jakob Junis, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred RHP Jose Corniell from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list, while C Danny Jansen was transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right forearm strain.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on July 30, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers. The Los Angeles Angels also made a trade, sending C Logan O'Hoppe and RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers in exchange for SS Angel Arredondo.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals lost to the Minnesota Twins 3-4 in a close game. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, failing to secure a win. Trent Grisham led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rangers RHP Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 29, 2026. The Texas Rangers right-hander will miss at least the next two weeks.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on July 30, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers.
